title: DC315 intumescent coating thermal-barrier evaluation
jurisdiction: Canada — national CCMC product evaluation; comparative attachment only, not a Calgary/Edmonton or Alberta project application

facts.text: The CCMC opinion covers DC315 used as a thermal barrier over spray-applied polyurethane foam insulation; several identified provisions are classified Alternative.
The report’s full-scale CAN/ULC-9705 comparison table lists a 20:00 result for DC315 at 24 mil in the 3.1.5.15.(2)(a) comparison and 11:00 at 20 mil for the 9.29.4 plastering comparison.
The table describes tests against prescribed acceptable-solution comparison materials; its reported results are tied to the report’s test method and installation conditions.
facts.locator: CCMC 14036-R PDF, p. 7, Table 2 and notes

limitations: This is not a universal thermal-barrier approval or project-specific fire conclusion.
Reported comparison outcomes are bounded by tested configuration and stated conditions.
